text: Every approval limit, range, floor, period and criterion that Epics 3 to 8 refer to is a versioned reference-data row loaded from the regulation and the approved policy. No limit or value is asserted in this document, and each acceptance criterion runs against the loaded version.
why: DL18 is open and no source states an approval limit, a settlement range, a floor or a period, so any number written here would be invented and would be quoted back as a business decision nobody took.

text: The settlement range and the floor price are read per product from versioned reference rows. Only a documented test version is used in SIT, and the production version is approved by the product head like the treatment policy.

text: The offer validity of 14 days stated in the rule rows is the documented test value. The cure period, the maximum number of breaks and the queue and approval service levels are parameters with no value until DL22 and DL23 are loaded.
